sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen3: Qwen3 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: We are making the weights of Qwen3 available to the public, including both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) models. The highlights from Qwen3 include: Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models of various sizes, available in 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B, 32B and 30B-A3B, 235B-A22B.

sources.title: GitHub - andrewleech/qwen3-asr-onnx
sources.snippet: Produces output/qwen3-asr-.6b/ (or 1.7b) with FP32 ONNX files. Encoder weights are embedded in the proto; decoder init and step use separate external weight files.
